title: RBAC v2 shadow rollout with customer consent-driven cutover and admin safeguards
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
High-level summary:
Implement a staged, consent-driven migration path from RBAC v1 -> RBAC v2 using a shadow-rollout pattern. Primary goals: avoid downtime, preserve audit fidelity, allow customer opt-in for early cutover, provide clear rollback and admin overrides, and ensure SSO/SAML role mappings and admin controls behave identically post-cutover.

Planned approach (phases):
1) Shadow write + read-compare (opt-in customers):
   - Deploy proxy layer ("shadow-proxy") that writes role changes to both v1 and v2 stores for opt-in customers. Reads continue from v1 by default but record v2 read results for comparison.
   - Add per-customer "RBAC v2 opt-in" toggle in Console and a minimal consent UI explaining audit implications.
   - Ensure every change is emitted to Audit Logging pipeline with a v1->v2 correlation id.

2) Backfill and reconciliation:
   - Run streaming backfill (rbac-backfill-runner-v2) to replay historical grants/role assignments into v2 for customers that opt in but have missing state.
   - Periodic batch reconciliation compares effective permissions between v1 and v2; produce discrepancy reports and automated repair suggestions.
   - Thresholds: block cutover if >0.1% of principals have critical-perm mismatches, or any admin/super-admin mismatch exists.

3) Canary cutover and monitoring:
   - Enroll customer cohorts by risk profile: internal infra teams -> low-risk customers -> high-risk customers.
   - For each cohort, enable reads from v2 for verification window (1h, 6h, 24h) while continuing dual-write.
   - Monitor reconciliation metrics, latency, error rates, and audit log completeness.

4) Final cutover flow (per-customer):
   - When consistency targets met, flip canonical read/write to v2 and mark v1 deprecated for that customer.
   - Keep v1 read-only for a retention window (30 days) and enable a fast rollback toggle that routes reads back to v1 and re-enables dual-write.

5) Deprecation and post-cutover validation:
   - Run golden prompt QA and policy checks against common admin flows (invite, role edit, SSO mapping changes).
   - Verify audit logs show identical event semantics, correlation ids present, and logs shipped to central store.

Operational safeguards and admin controls:
- Admin rollback toggle per-tenant in Console with audit trail and two-person approval for enterprise tenants.
- Automatic safety lock if reconciliation error spikes, escalating to on-call security and infra.
- Keep an "emergency backout" script that re-enables dual-write and read-routing to v1 within 90s.

SSO/SAML considerations:
- Validate SSO attribute mapping (group->role) parity between v1 and v2 using an attribute mapping test harness.
- Include SAML metadata versioning and explicit mapping migration notes in customer comms.

Audit logging and observability:
- Tag every RBAC event with fields: source_version (v1|v2), correlation_id, customer_id, actor_id, change_set_id.
- Add dashboards and alerts: mismatch_rate_by_customer, admin_action_latency, audit_event_drop_rate.
- Require end-to-end verification before final cutover: sample log replays and redaction checks.

Comms and customer-facing changes:
- Customer-facing email + Console banner that explains opt-in path, expected behavior, and rollback guarantees.
- Provide a short FAQ doc and a migration checklist for SSO owners.
- Offer a scheduled migration window for enterprise customers with dedicated SE support.

Rollout metrics and success criteria:
- Zero P0 security incidents attributable to migration.
- Discrepancy rate < 0.05% sustained for 24h before per-customer final cutover.
- Audit event parity > 99.99% across v1/v2 during shadow period.

Runbooks and artifacts to produce for this ticket:
- Console toggle UI spec and copy for consent modal.
- Shadow proxy deployment manifest and feature flag gating.
- Backfill runner idempotency and retry spec.
- Reconciliation queries and dashboard panels.
- Customer comms templates and SE playbook for enterprise migrations.

2025-03-01 QA: Ran end-to-end SAML mapping tests against the harness. Found mismatches for nested-group resolution; created followup ENG-27901 to address nested-group logic.
